description: This file contains utility functions for generating and evaluating exams, including filtering deprecated questions, selecting random questions and answers, and computing exam results.

methods.name: filterDeprecated
methods.description: Filters out objects with deprecated: true from an array.

methods.name: getRandomElement
methods.description: Selects a random element from an array.

methods.name: generateRandomExam
methods.description: Generates a randomized exam with questions and answers.

methods.name: createExamResults
methods.description: Calculates exam results based on user answers and original exam data.
